kgs.as_bilingual_pair_policy: Preserve Wolof/French paired statements as a single mixed-language candidate when they express the same competency or objective; do not translate for v0; keep original text and language tags.
kgs.as_duplicate_review_instructions: Review Senegal CE1 bilingual Wolof/French candidates conservatively. Treat a Wolof paragraph followed by a French paragraph as one bilingual/mixed-language item when the French restates the Wolof. Merge duplicates caused by table row filldown, repeated headers, or repeated Objectif d’apprentissage / Nisaru njàng context within the same activity, palier/jéego, table, and objective context. Keep separate candidates when they occur in different activities (for example Expression orale vs Récitation, Lecture vs Production d’écrits), different paliers/jéego, different weeks, or different objective contexts, unless they are clearly the same curriculum item repeated for layout reasons. Do not use table numbers, section numbers, week labels, palier/jéego numbers, or objective-order numbers as merge identities.

kgs.as_repeated_statement_policy: For no-code rows, merge exact or near-exact repeated Wolof/French statements only when they share the same source role, activity/domain, palier/jéego, table/local_code, and objective context. In detailed oral/lecture tables, repeated Objectif d’apprentissage values may span several weekly rows; treat those repeated broad objectives as one contextual grouping or broad standard within the same activity and palier, while keeping distinct Objectifs spécifiques and weekly practice items separate. Do not merge recurring weekly practice items merely because wording is similar.
kgs.as_sfi_extraction_instructions:
This is a no-stable-code Senegal CE1 bilingual Wolof/French language-and-communication curriculum. Extract StandardsFrameworkItems from normative curriculum statements, not from pedagogical directions alone. Create Standard Grouping SFIs for the framework, CE1/Étape 2, subdomains/activities such as Communication orale, Lecture, Communication écrite, Production d’écrits, Récitation, paliers/jéego/niveaux, and objective contexts when they organize leaf expectations. Use Outils de langue / Jumtukaayi làkk as an activity/domain grouping when it appears as section or table context; row-level tool-category labels such as Baataan/Vocabulaire, Grammaire, Conjugaison, Orthographe, and Écriture/Copie are local grouping/context labels, not leaf standards by themselves. Create Standard SFIs for Compétence de cycle, Compétence de l’étape, Compétences de sous-domaines, Compétences de base, Objectif d’apprentissage / Nisaru njàng, and Objectifs spécifiques / Nisaru jukki bi when they state what learners are expected to integrate, understand, produce, read, copy, recite, or demonstrate. In detailed oral and lecture tables, the Objectif d’apprentissage column usually contains a broad objective repeated across multiple weekly rows, while Objectifs spécifiques contains the main leaf objectives; emit at most one candidate per distinct repeated Objectif d’apprentissage in a single window and use all visible supporting row indexes, rather than duplicating the same broad objective for every row. In detailed production-writing tables, section headings such as Objectif d’apprentissage 2 / Nisaru njàng 2 may be extracted as broad objective context when the full objective text is visible, but the numeric ordinal alone is not an SFI or statement_code. Treat Contenus / Këmb / Limu ëmb, Durée / Diir, week labels including 1 à 8 or single week numbers, INTÉGRATION, and EVALUATION rows as metadata, descriptors, guidance, or sequencing evidence unless the row itself contains a clear normative objective. Use rows_filldown for interpreting implied palier/week/objective context, but cite raw rows/cells for source fidelity. Do not create a new SFI just because a filldown value repeats across multiple rows. When a cell contains Wolof followed by French conveying the same item, keep them together as one mixed-language candidate with language='mul'. This document has no stable item-level statement codes; do not use table numbers (for example Tableau 1.1.1), section numbers, week numbers, palier/jéego numbers, or objective-order numbers as statement_code. Treat them as provenance or hierarchy context only, and set statement_code to null unless a source row contains a true official item code.

Use only the canonical statement_type values from as_statement_type_policy. For this Senegal Reading curriculum, classify source roles as: Référentiel, Étape, Section, Sous-domaine, Activité, Compétence de cycle, Compétence de l'étape, Compétence de sous-domaine, Compétence de base, Palier, Compétence de palier, Objectif d'apprentissage, or Objectif spécifique. Use Palier only for label-only palier/jéego/sumb groupings or headings; use Compétence de palier for full normative Jéego/Jëego/Sumb/Palier competency statements. Use Sous-domaine for Communication orale or Communication écrite; use Activité for activity organizers such as Expression orale, Récitation, Lecture, Lecture-écriture, Production d’écrits, Copie, or Outils de langue. Do not use English or compound output labels such as Framework, Stage/Grade, Activity, Domain, Sub-domain, Activity/Domain, Tool category, Palier/Jéego, or Objectif spécifique / Nisaru jukki bi.

kgs.lc_generation_instructions: Generate LearningComponents only from final leaf expectation SFIs, especially Objectifs spécifiques / Nisaru jukki bi and clear learning objectives under Oral, Lecture, Communication écrite, Production d’écrits, Outils de langue, and Copie. Do not generate LearningComponents from durations, week numbers, integration/evaluation rows, table captions, generic section headings, row-level tool-category labels alone, or broad Objectif d’apprentissage grouping/context nodes when a more specific leaf objective is available. Preserve original Wolof/French wording for v0; no English translation is required.
